arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to pgbouncer connection pool refresh. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. Ran a query against the read replica to export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to determine the root cause of the failures and implement necessary fixes to clear the backlog.
